data.body: Classification: behavioral, Score 3 (INTERMEDIATE). Root cause: dso-setup.sh wrote absolute home-cache path to dso-config.conf; onboarding SKILL.md prescribed absolute paths. Fix: (1) dso-setup.sh skips writing dso.plugin_root when PLUGIN_ROOT starts with $HOME/.claude/; (2) shim template + live shim add step (2.5) home-cache autodetect; (3) onboarding SKILL.md updated with auto-resolution chain guidance. Tests: 2 new RED tests (both GREEN after fix).
